Package domaincontrollers

Class CtrlTransformData

java.lang.Object
domaincontrollers.CtrlTransformData
public class CtrlTransformData extends Object
Controller for transforming form data between model and view layers. Handles form creation, editing, answering, and data presentation. Provides methods to convert domain objects to presentation-friendly maps and vice versa.
Author:
Joel Forcadell (joel.forcadell@estudiantat.upc.edu), Artur Leivar (artur.leivar@estudiantat.upc.edu), Pau Turró Gómez (pau.turro.gomez@estudiantat.upc.edu)
